messages.subject: semTools 0.5-1 available on CRAN
parts:
In conjunction with the release of lavaan 0.6-3 on CRAN, semTools 0.5-1 is now available on CRAN.  Please find details about the updates (mainly involving missing-data and measurement-invariance functionality) on the semTools Wiki:

https://github.com/simsem/semTools/wiki

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Postdoctoral Researcher, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
